items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: And as soon as we got through playing, we went over there and shook hands with Duke

ctx.x: Now one time, I think--I don't know whether it was Kirk or Moten played out to Duke, but as usual, there was no contest. Now we played against-- opposite Duke one time. And as soon as we got through playing, we went over there and shook hands with Duke, even before they started, you know, (laughter) say, "you win." (laughter) Now this is the truth, it is with that band--
Which one are you talking of now?
